quotes.quote: This document defines a standard interchange format for describing vulnerabilities in open source packages.
This format is stable, but further backwards compatible changes may still be made.
The id and modified fields are required. For schema versions above 1.0.0, the schema_version field is also required.

In the ranges field, the type field is required. It specifies the type of version range being recorded and defines the interpretation of the events object’s introduced, fixed, and any type-specific fields.
GIT: The versions introduced and fixed are full-length Git commit hashes.
introduced allows a version of the value "0" to represent a version that sorts before any other version.
If no limit events are provided, an implicit { "limit": "*" } is assumed to exist.
last_affected should be thought of as the hard ceiling of the vulnerability at the time of publication in the absence of a fixed version.
The meaning of the values within the object is entirely defined by the database and beyond the scope of this document.
This field is required if affected[].ranges[].type is GIT.
The versions introduced and fixed are arbitrary, uninterpreted strings specific to the package ecosystem, which does not conform to SemVer 2.0’s version ordering.
Specifying one or more GIT ranges does NOT remove the requirement to specify an explicitly enumerated versions list
these version strings are not guaranteed to exactly match versions of the package found in the upstream package repository
There must be at least one introduced object in the events array.
